question.string: Which poet wrote the most books?

query.sparql:
SELECT?author?count
WHERE {
 ?author <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/occupation> <http://dbpedia.org/resource/Poet>.
 ?author <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/author>?author.
 ?author <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#type> <http://dbpedia.org/ontology/Book>.
 ?author?book?count.
  GROUP BY?author
  HAVING COUNT(?book) > 1
  ORDER BY COUNT(?book) DESC
  LIMIT 1
}
